body.title: Apply selected budgets to runtime acquisition and resource closure
body.summary: Update timing fields only in src/installer/runtime-metadata.ts and existing src/installer/runtime-acquire.ts, src/installer/runtime-store.ts, src/installer/controller-store.ts, src/installer/bootstrap-foundation.ts, src/installer/runtime-archive.ts and src/installer/download.ts consumers. Cover deadline wrappers, ZIP decoder drains and enclosing resource guards. Keep src/installer/owned-file.ts successful-close semantics; it has no standalone close timer. Audit actual related callers for hidden normal caps without redesigning resource ownership.
acceptanceChecks: slow-vm acquisition/download/extraction40min, read-only verification/publication8min and existing resource/decoder drains30s reach actual helper timers; normal600s/120s/5s remain.
downloadBoundedAsset retains its owner's signal; no redundant shorter hidden acquisition cap or invented synchronous-close timeout.
RUNTIME_LIMITS shape, structural byte/count caps, independent integrity pins, headers/npm binding, durable writes and actual resource closure remain unchanged.
Accelerated cancellation/uncertainty tests confirm expiry never authorizes stage removal or successful publication.
